an3.155:1.1: ye bhikkhave sattā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti manasā sucaritaṃ caranti supubbaṇho bhikkhave tesaṃ sattānaṃ
an3.155:2.1: ye bhikkhave sattā majjhantikasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti manasā sucaritaṃ caranti sumajjhantiko bhikkhave tesaṃ sattānaṃ
an3.155:3.1: ye bhikkhave sattā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti manasā sucaritaṃ caranti susāyaṇho bhikkhave tesaṃ sattānanti.
